title: OpenFang: an "Agent OS" where you spin up autonomous workers

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: If you are tired of AI agents that just sit there waiting for you to type a prompt, you need to see OpenFang. It's an agent OS where you spin up autonomous workers. They call them hands to continuously map out research, scrape data, or generate leads on a schedule. You set the parameters and they just run. I have to respect the developer flex here. It's a 137,000line Rust codebase shipped as a single binary with literally zero clippy warnings.
